awarding_body.value: American Association of Critical-Care Nurses Certification Corporation (AACN Certification Corporation)

credential_description.value: CSC is a subspecialty certification for already-certified nurses who provide direct care to acutely/critically ill adult cardiac surgery patients in the first 48 hours postoperatively. It is attached to an underlying clinical specialty certification (e.g., CCRN, PCCN) rather than standing alone.

year_launched.note: AACN does not publish a launch year for the CSC subspecialty on its current pages; left null rather than guessing.

eligibility.value: A current, unencumbered U.S. RN or APRN license is required, plus a current nationally accredited clinical nursing specialty certification (to which the CSC credential is attached). Clinical practice hours must meet ONE of two options. Two-Year Option: 1,750 hours in direct care of acutely/critically ill adult patients over the previous two years, with 875 in the most recent year, of which 875 must be in care of acutely/critically ill adult cardiac surgery patients within the first 48 hours postoperatively. Five-Year Option: at least 2,000 hours over the previous five years, with 144 in the most recent year, of which 1,000 must be in care of acutely/critically ill adult cardiac surgery patients within the first 48 hours postoperatively. Hours must be completed in a U.S./Canada-based or comparable facility and be verifiable by a clinical supervisor or professional colleague.

exam_format.value: Computer-based, multiple-choice exam administered through AACN's testing service (PSI). The exam contains 90 total items, of which 75 are scored and 15 are unscored pretest items, with a 2-hour time limit. A paper-based option is also available through AACN.

passing_score.value: Cut (passing) score of 55 correct out of 75 scored items, effective 01/31/2022. The passing score is a raw number, not a percentage, set via the modified-Angoff method with PSI psychometricians.

fee.value: Initial exam fee: $145 for AACN members, $235 for nonmembers. Renewal-by-exam fee: $120 for members, $165 for nonmembers. Renewal-by-CERPs (synergy/processing) fee: $75 for members, $130 for nonmembers.

renewal.value: CSC certification is valid for three years, beginning the first day of the month the candidate passed the exam. Renewal options: (1) Renewal by Synergy CERPs requires 25 Category A Clinical Judgment CERPs within the three-year cycle plus continued clinical practice (432 hours of direct care of adult postoperative cardiac patients, with 144 hours within the most recent 12 months); or (2) Renewal by exam (retake the CSC exam).
renewal.clinical_practice_hours: 432 hours over 3 years, 144 in most recent 12 months

common_confusions.value: CSC vs. CMC: both are AACN subspecialty add-on credentials administered identically (90 items, 75 scored). CMC (Cardiac Medicine Certification) covers acutely/critically ill adult cardiac patients broadly, while CSC is specific to the first 48 hours after cardiac surgery. CSC vs. CCRN: CCRN is a standalone broad critical-care credential; CSC is a subspecialty that attaches to an existing certification like CCRN or PCCN and cannot stand alone.

salary_context.note: BLS OEWS does not break out cardiac surgery nurses specifically; no CSC-specific salary figure verifiable, left null.

recent_changes.value: First-time pass rate fell sharply from 69.70% (2023) to 51.30% (2024) and 52.20% (2025), likely reflecting updated exam content following the 2020 National Practice Analysis of Cardiac Surgery Nurses. Current passing (cut) score of 55 has been in effect since 01/31/2022.

discrepancies.detail: The mounted Content Outline CSV lists blueprint weights as Procedures 11%, Complications 33%, Therapeutic Interventions 43%, Monitoring & Diagnostics 13%. The current AACN-sourced blueprint (CSC Exam Handbook / Mometrix corroboration) lists 19% / 31% / 36% / 15%. Used the AACN-aligned weights (19/31/36/15) as the more authoritative current values; flagged for user review.
An initial web search surfaced $120/$165 fees, but those are AACN's renewal-by-exam fees. The official CSC Get Certified page lists the initial exam fee as $145 (member) / $235 (nonmember).
discrepancies.resolution: Used official initial fee $145/$235 for the page exam-fee figures.
